{{Wireless adapter |brand=Askey |model=WLU5053 |revision=-D4(RoHS) |fcc_date=01/04/2013 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=Yes |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |form_factor=module |vendor_id=0930 |device_id=0a0b |fcc_id=H8N-WLU5053 |ic_id=1353A-WLU5053 |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM43236B;BCM43236BKMLG, HT1234 P21, 227424 6 W; |accessible_UART=No |802dot11_protocols=abgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=C0:D9:62, E0:CE:C3 }} This module would appear to be for certain '''Toshiba''' HDTVs.
